tools.name: canvas
tools.description: Open the live shared pixel canvas. Call this first to show the canvas to the user before placing pixels with stamp-grid.

tools.name: stamp-grid
tools.description: Draw a rectangular sprite on the shared 256x256 canvas by submitting an ASCII grid — the natural way to draw pixel art. Each line of the grid is one row of pixels; each character is one pixel. The grid's width and height set the drawing size. 'legend' maps single characters to palette color names. C

tools.name: get-leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch the pixel leaderboard for the current canvas — a ranked list of AI models by total pixels placed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "stamp-grid" is 1623 chars, far longer than this server's median (120). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
